القرآن الكريم هو كلام الله غير المخلوق، المعجز بلفظه ومعناه، المنزه عن سمات النقص الشيطاني. صدقه مطلق، ودلائله في الإعجاز البياني، الغيبي، والتشريعي، والكوني الحديث (كأطوار الجنين وتوسع الكون) تثبت أنه تنزيل من حكيم حميد، إذ يدعو إلى الفضائل والتوحيد، بينما الشيطان لا يأمر إلا بالسوء والفحشاء. 

بيان قوي لصدق القرآن ونفي شبهة الشيطان:
تناقض القرآن مع غايات الشيطان: الشيطان يريد الغواية، والمعصية، والتفريق، والشرك. القرآن يأمر بالتوحيد، الأخلاق، التقوى، والبر، وينهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر والبغي. هل يعقل أن يأمر الشيطان بعبادة الله وترك عبادة الشيطان؟ هذا تناقض عقلي لا يقبله عاقل.
الغيبيات القرآنية (دليل تاريخي): أخبر القرآن عن أمور مستقبلية وتحققت، كغلبة الروم في بضع سنين، وحفظ الله للقرآن من التحريف، بينما الشيطان كاذب ومخادع، لا يعلم الغيب، وقوله مبني على التخمين والفتنة.
الإعجاز العلمي الحديث: آيات تتحدث عن أدق تفاصيل علم الأجنة، ونشأة الكون، وحركة الفلك، مما لم يكن معلوماً وقت نزوله، مما يدل على أنه من خلق الكون (الله) وليس من تأليف بشر أو شيطان.
سلامته من التناقض: لو كان من عند غير الله، لوجدوا فيه تناقضات واختلافات، كما قال تعالى: {وَلَوْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ غَيْرِ اللَّهِ لَوَجَدُوا فِيهِ اخْتِلافًا كَثِيرًا}.
عتاب الله للنبي: تضمن القرآن آيات تعاتب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم (مثل سورة عبس، وأحداث سورة الأحزاب). الشيطان يرفع من شأن حزبه، ولا يعاتب من يتبعه بذكر نقائصه أمام الملأ.
حفظه وتواتره: {إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ}. الشيطان يسعى للمحو والتحريف، والقرآن محفوظ في الصدور والسطور بحروفه وكلماته. 
القرآن الكريم هو كلام الله تعالى المنزل على نبيه محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، المعجز بلفظه ومعناه، المتعبد بتلاوته، المنقول بالتواتر، المحفوظ من الزيادة والنقصان، وهو البرهان الدائم على صدق النبوة.   ا

After all,  in 94 years of sometimes contentious ceremonies - NO ONE has ever resorted to such barbaric and violent behavior over anything - let alone something so trite. -  
especially outrageous considering the millions who lost their lives to a virulent pathogen in the last 2 years upending hundreds of millions of lives around the globe -  
and now the millions of innocent people who are risking their lives every single day, fighting for their home country and their family's survival,  while fending off a brutal, ruthless, soulless dictator who is intentionally targeting hospitals and schools, and kiIIing innocent children and pregnant women ....

While the act was horrible, the sad thing is that because people thought that Chris Rock knew about Jada´s disease (whih he later told that he didn´t), then it is actually understandable that it feels horrible for both Jada and Smith to think someone just made fun of something very personal and painful for Jada. While he could still have acted differently, I would actually have been really unconfortable seeing my wife hurt by a man bullying her for her disease, especially in front of a live audience. 
If Chris Rock had actually known that she had a disease, it would have been extremely disrespectful, and given that they thought he knew, they might have felt that he somewhat humiliated her in front of the entire world.
That doesn´t mean that the action is okay, but it does make it much more understandable.

The saddest thing though, is that lots of the people hating on Will Smith would not do it to the same degree if somewhat did this to someone they knew in real life, especially if the person who did it was really popular and the person he did it to was unpopular.

rows.text:
​ القرآن الكريم هو المعجزة الخالدة، وتتجلى إعجازاته في سبقه العلمي للحقائق الكونية، والجنينية، والجيولوجية التي اكتشفها العلم الحديث، مما يثبت مصدره الإلهي. أبرزها مراحل خلق الجنين، نشأة الكون (الانفجار العظيم)، توسع الكون، وتكون السحب، وتطور الجبال، والتي لم تكن معروفة عند نزوله. 
أبرز المعجزات التي اكتشفها العلم الحديث في القرآن:
مراحل خلق الجنين: وصف القرآن بدقة مراحل تطور الجنين (نطفة، علقة، مضغة، عظام، لحم) كما جاء في سورة المؤمنون الآيات 12-14، وهو ما لم يكشفه الطب إلا بالمجاهر الحديثة.
نشأة الكون (الانفجار العظيم): الإشارة إلى أن الكون كان وحدة واحدة ثم انفتقت في قوله تعالى: {أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا} [سورة الأنبياء: 30].
توسع الكون: أشار القرآن إلى توسع الكون في قوله تعالى: {وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْيدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ} [سورة الذاريات: 47]، وهو اكتشاف فلكي حديث.
حقيقة أن السماوات والأرض كانت "دخانًا": في سورة فصلت: {ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ}، وتطابق هذه الآية نظريات الفيزياء الحديثة حول حالة الكون الأولية.
حركة الشمس والنجوم: ذكر القرآن جريان الشمس في مسار محدد في قوله تعالى: {وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا} [سورة يس: 38]، وهو ما يؤكد حركة الشمس الدقيقة التي اكتشفها العلم.
حواجز البحار (البرزخ المائي): الإشارة إلى وجود برزخ بين البحرين في قوله تعالى: {مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ * بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ} [سورة الرحمن: 19-20]، وهو ما يفسره العلم الحديث بظاهرة الاختلاف في ملوحة وكثافة ودرجة حرارة مياه البحار.
الجبال كأوتاد: وصف القرآن الجبال بأنها "أوتاد" [سورة النبأ: 7]، وهو ما أكدته الجيولوجيا الحديثة بأن للجبال جذوراً عميقة في الأرض تثبت القشرة الأرضية.
ظلمات أعماق المحيطات: ذكرت الآية {أَوْ كَظُلُمَاتٍ فِي بَحْرٍ لُّجِّيٍّ يَغْشَاهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ} [سورة النور: 40] حقيقة وجود ظلمات في أعماق البحار، حيث لا يصل الضوء إلا بعد آلاف الأمتار.

القرآن الكريم هو كلام الله غير المخلوق، المعجز بلفظه ومعناه، المنزه عن سمات النقص الشيطاني. صدقه مطلق، ودلائله في الإعجاز البياني، الغيبي، والتشريعي، والكوني الحديث (كأطوار الجنين وتوسع الكون) تثبت أنه تنزيل من حكيم حميد، إذ يدعو إلى الفضائل والتوحيد، بينما الشيطان لا يأمر إلا بالسوء والفحشاء. 

بيان قوي لصدق القرآن ونفي شبهة الشيطان:
تناقض القرآن مع غايات الشيطان: الشيطان يريد الغواية، والمعصية، والتفريق، والشرك. القرآن يأمر بالتوحيد، الأخلاق، التقوى، والبر، وينهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر والبغي. هل يعقل أن يأمر الشيطان بعبادة الله وترك عبادة الشيطان؟ هذا تناقض عقلي لا يقبله عاقل.
الغيبيات القرآنية (دليل تاريخي): أخبر القرآن عن أمور مستقبلية وتحققت، كغلبة الروم في بضع سنين، وحفظ الله للقرآن من التحريف، بينما الشيطان كاذب ومخادع، لا يعلم الغيب، وقوله مبني على التخمين والفتنة.
الإعجاز العلمي الحديث: آيات تتحدث عن أدق تفاصيل علم الأجنة، ونشأة الكون، وحركة الفلك، مما لم يكن معلوماً وقت نزوله، مما يدل على أنه من خلق الكون (الله) وليس من تأليف بشر أو شيطان.
سلامته من التناقض: لو كان من عند غير الله، لوجدوا فيه تناقضات واختلافات، كما قال تعالى: {وَلَوْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ غَيْرِ اللَّهِ لَوَجَدُوا فِيهِ اخْتِلافًا كَثِيرًا}.
عتاب الله للنبي: تضمن القرآن آيات تعاتب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم (مثل سورة عبس، وأحداث سورة الأحزاب). الشيطان يرفع من شأن حزبه، ولا يعاتب من يتبعه بذكر نقائصه أمام الملأ.
حفظه وتواتره: {إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ}. الشيطان يسعى للمحو والتحريف، والقرآن محفوظ في الصدور والسطور بحروفه وكلماته. 
القرآن الكريم هو كلام الله تعالى المنزل على نبيه محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، المعجز بلفظه ومعناه، المتعبد بتلاوته، المنقول بالتواتر، المحفوظ من الزيادة والنقصان، وهو البرهان الدائم على صدق النبوة.   ا

rows.text:
For those who are new to this -  
 
Chris Rock said:

“Jada, I love you. G.I. Jane 2, can’t wait to see it.”

This was a joke referencing the 1997 movie G.I. Jane, in which actress Demi Moore played a Navy SEAL trainee with a shaved head.  
 

Why It Was Offensive: 
	•	Jada Pinkett Smith suffers from alopecia, a medical condition that causes hair loss.
	•	She had spoken publicly about her struggle with it and even shaved her head because of it.
	•	The joke, therefore, seemed to make fun of her appearance and medical condition, which many people (including Will Smith) found insensitive and hurtful.

rows.text: G.I. Jane is a film that tells the fictional story of a woman joining the special forces (of the army) in the USA. In the film, G.I. Jane is portrayed with very short hair (mostly shaven). The short hair cut being part of the rules for joining the special forces. Jada Smith (in the audience near to Will Smith - she rolls her eyes after the joke) had very short hair at that time due to her alopecia (she says she has a medical condition causing hair loss). By saying "Jada, I love ya. G.I. Jane 2, can't wait to see it, alright", Chris Rock is making a joke by drawing a comparison between the fictional character G.I. Jane and the real person Jada Smith.

スミスさんの行動は褒められたものではありませんでした。
ですが、家族への想い、人の痛みに気づくことのできることは誇るべきです。
日本には「言葉の暴力」とゆうものがあります。
暴力を振るわなくても言葉で相手を傷付けてしまう事を言います。
傷つける言葉かどうかは人それぞれで違うので、この言葉は使ってはいけないなんてことは言えません。
大事なのは相手が傷ついた事に気付けるかどうか、そして、そのことを認めて心から謝罪出来るかが大事だと思います。
この件でスミスさんは家族想いで、優しい人なんだと思いました。

貴方の想いは何も間違っていない！全世界の人が否定し批判しようと、スミスさんの家族を想う心は素晴らしいと思います。

どうかその想いを忘れずに貴方のままでいてください。
そして、人を思いやる心を世界に広げてください。
そうすれば国や文化、人種なんて関係なく友達になれる世界になると思います。

あなたにはそれができると信じています。

日本の片隅でいつまでも応援しています。

rows.text:
Will, i doubt youll see this, but I want to give you correct information regarding emotional processing.

When you say "Im trying not to be ashamed of myself, but rather deeply remoresful" - this is not the correct psychological route to take. Youve likely been advised that shame is bad, toxic, etc. That is wrong - it is REPRESSED or INTERNALIZED shame that is harmful.

Instead, in a situation like this, you need to allow that shame to be FELT. In a situation like this, shame is the natural emotion to come up. You need to hold space for that feeling. It is very painful. It also is HUMBLING. After you face the feelings of shame, sit with them, you will feel completely humbled, but there will be a RELIEF that floods you. You will no longer be resisting your own emotions. Youll no longer be fighting them. And you will be so much wiser as a result.

Remorse is also necessary, but it is repressed shame which our culture does not properly deal with, and many stuggle due tp that fact. With your influence, if you deal with this properly and allow yourself to be vulnerable, you could really make a huge impact in the world.

@deathwish374  feeling is healing my friend. It may seem strange, but actually by resisting the feeling of repressed shame, you are perpetuating it within you. By letting go and allowing yourself to feel your true emotions, you allow those emotions to process. All is temporary, and all will pass. However, the only way out is through. 

 Sitting with that discomfort for 10 minutes, or 30 minutes, or however long the uncomfortable emotions want to stay for, can have a life changing effect of allowing them to flow. In its place, self-love will flow in. You will have given an "untouchable" part of you the space to exist for the first time, without trying to destroy or get rid of it. This is massively relaxing to the parasympathetic nervous system, and it seems difficult, but once you do it you really it wasn't that hard, and there was nothing to worry about in the first place. :) 💚

rows.text:
Dear Will,
I am not a "Youtube" person.
In 14(ish?) years I've never made a comment on this site.
A lot of people are being critical, a lot of people are spreading fanatical hate and/or love.
I just want to say you have been a huge part of my life. You, via media, have helped me live, laugh and cry. I was heartbroken by your actions that night.
I forgive you. I hope you can forgive yourself, too.
 Your on-screen relationship with James Avery in Fresh Prince meant the world to me growing up without a father figure in my life.I recall a very hard time in my life, where you and James taught me that mistakes happen, and not only can the people around you forgive you, but you can forgive yourself.
I appreciate you owning that your behavior was wrong. We all make mistakes, Will. I hope you forgive yourself. I hope Chris forgives you, and I hope you both can heal from it.

rows.text:
Its incredible how judgemental and unforgiving people are. As if they are perfect and have never made horrible mistakes or lapses in judgement before. Or the people who are hypocritical about who they give the benefit of the doubt to. 

Will Smith is a good person, who had an awful moment. The key word is moment, not lifestyle. Except unlike us regular joe’s and even some celebs, Will had his terrible moment in front of millions of viewers. 

If we had read about this happening in some news article and it wasn’t televised, it wouldn’t have gotten the attention it did and some people would have even questioned whether it was true or not. But it didn’t happen that way. 

So guess what? The world saw that, surprise, Will Smith is a flawed human being, just like the rest of us. People can stand on their fake “holier than thou” platforms if they want.  But we all know some of the most vile people are doing things that will never be televised. 

Any sane person can look at the way this man looked before he even started talking and see that he is still doing his own soul searching. He’s still trying to forgive himself. 

When we see people who are truly remorseful and expressing it, instead of assuming the worst, we need to start giving them the space to change. What people like Will need in those moments are love, support and encouragement. Not condemnation by people who are just as flawed.

Will Smith, you are still loved, supported and have a voice that this world needs. Stay strong and stay encouraged brother.

rows.text:
Coney Island Chili Dogs

Ingredients:

- 1 1/2 pounds lean ground beef
- 2 cups of water
- 3/4 cup diced onion
- 1/3 cup ketchup
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 2 cloves garlic
- 2 tablespoons chili powder
- 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
- 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
- 1 pinch cayenne pepper
- 8 all-beef hot dogs 
- 8 hot dog buns
- 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard

Directions:

1. Combine ground beef, water, 1/2 cup diced onion, ketchup, butter, garlic, chili powder, salt, black pepper, cumin, celery salt, and cayenne pepper together in a pot. Mix with a potato masher or spatula over medium-high heat until mixture has a finely ground consistency and begins to bubble, about 10 minutes.
2. Bring beef mixture to a simmer, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and reduces, about 1 hour. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook hot dogs in boiling water until heated through, 5 to 7 minutes.
4. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Arrange hot dog buns on a baking sheet.
5. Cook buns in the preheated oven until soft and warm, 2 to 3 minutes.
6. Place 1 bun on a plate. Place a hot dog in the bun and top with meat sauce. Drizzle yellow mustard and a portion of remaining diced onion over the meat sauce. Repeat with remaining hot dogs.

Я считаю, он поступил как мямля, пришел на ковер и объясняет всем как школьник что и почему. Как мне кажется, ему стоило поступить следующим образом:

1. Лично извиниться перед Крисом, когда тот будет готов. Или отправить сообщение/письмо.
2. Если помирились, сделать совместную фотку и выложить ее в соцсети с подписью вроде "мы все уладили :)"
Если не общались и не помирились, кратко оповестить мир, что "я жалею о содеянном, отправил письмо Крису, надеюсь, он выйдет на связь".
3. Сделать пост или записать КОРОТКОЕ видео с посылом извинения за то, что он испортил людям вечеринку и бросил тень на церемонию (ой ли? Рейтинги взлетели), ясно и коротко, "был неправ, сорян". И не с видом побитой собаки, а с чувством достоинства, что он как мужчина понимает свою ошибку и стойко встречает последствия.

А то как по мне выходит типичная для школы ситуация: тихоня заехал задире под глаз и в итоге его заставили перед ним прилюдно извиниться, хотя задира очень даже заслужил.

Цитата "...сколько людей пострадало" -- Ой, ну прям вообще, неизгладимая психологическая травма у всех разом. Столько слов, столько извинений, как будто он похитил пятнадцать младенцев и ставил над ними опыты. Перегиб. 🤦🏻 Мужики были, есть и будут отыгрываться на физиономиях друг друга, и что, каждый увидевший это страшно страдает? К тому же, это была лишь пощечина как акт унижения, а не кулаком в нос, чтоб перелом, кровь, сопли, слезы и слюни, молчу уже о преступном добивании ногами. Я смотрю, американцы любят раздувать из мухи слона и закрывать глаза на реального слона, усердно делая вид, что его не замечают.

Другое дело, что можно было оставить это на закулесье, крикнуть Крису, мол, "я с тобой после шоу поговорю, а сейчас Нормально извинись перед моей женой, или бла бла бла", можно и без "или".

Нужно думать, что и кому ты говоришь, и отвечать за свои слова. А то, видите ли, при толпе обидно шутить можно, а получить леща за это -- нельзя, сразу вонь поднимается. Похоже на то, что черные заигрались с черными. Черным можно говорить то, за что осудят белого, можно наезжать на другого черного так, как нельзя белому. Бравый мужик-ведущий пошутил над женщиной и огреб от бравого мужика-мужа, а мужик-муж теперь сидит и унижается. Интересно, какого жене из-за этого, он ее как бы защитил, а потом побежал видяшки-извиняшки записывать (опустим, что она токсик и тиран; просто, сам факт такой последовательности событий). Джада будет чмырить его после этого ещё сильнее.

 А у мамы Криса не прощения нужно просить, а сказать, чтоб великовозрастного сына научила чему-то большему, чем шуткам за 300. Все-таки в обществе давно сложены представления о том, какими в большинстве своем себя хотят видеть женщины и мужчины; женщины не хотят быть лысыми, а мужчины иметь маленький член. Так же тупо и бестактно шутить над, не знаю, прыщами, инвалидностью, кривыми зубами, картавостью и тд, если не известно отношение "жертвы" к этому состоянию. Если сам комик один из них, пусть шутит о себе, не задевая других, и может кто-то словит интересное наблюдение и тоже посмеется.
 
Борьба с "токсичной" маскулинностью приводит к тому, что мужчины становятся мямлями, нытиками, слабаками и хлюпиками, эстрогеновыми лошадками. А женщины в ответ на это грубыми, мужеподобными, агрессивными тестостероновыми конями. И в итоге получаем больное, извращенное общество.

Will Smith, I trust that you are sincere in your apology after listening to your interview with David Letterman. Something clearly got triggered in you to be able to do what you did. It's a drag that people have been so extremely critical, but you will survive this, sir. Know that their reactions are a reflection of their own inner pain and struggles, and it's so much easier to point the finger and blame than to look within.   If one is truly awakened, one doesn't need to judge another. We are all on this journey of life together, all make mistakes, all seek forgiveness for things we've done... all returning to the spirit of love, compassion, kindness, creativity, and our true divinity, in whatever way we define that...  we humans are all works in progress!
I know that you know this.! Keep searching your heart and return to that state of love for yourself and others that heals all wounds (even if it takes the others longer). May you be blessed with love and light!

rows.text:
Fair enough for now.  I get what you're saying, Will.  You are no more defined by the unskillful actions than the skillfully ones.  You're not gold, nor are you a POS.
It's hard to be human these days, as trauma us ubiquitous, but many have less of a load, and will not understand.  
It's not easy to heal from our childhoods, and it will require a willingness to accept mistakes.  As you know, it doesn't excuse the behavior, but it is explanative if one wishes to understand.  Glad that in your case here, nobody was seriously injured, and that you will be working towards guilt for an action vs. shame for who you are.
You're not alone in this difficult process, but for those that do not understand, you will be judged and labeled.  Not fair, but telling as to this culture's tolerance for mistakes, and our failure to understand that growth and change come require mistakes. Perfection expected from others is a sign of perfection expected from self, so that judgments are an expression of the judging, not the judge.
Wishing you well during this difficult time.

rows.text:
MS-DOS acronym for Microsoft Disk Operating System, also known as Microsoft DOS) is an operating system for x86-based personal computers mostly developed by Microsoft. Collectively, MS-DOS, its rebranding as IBM PC DOS, and a few operating systems attempting to be compatible with MS-DOS, are sometimes referred to as "DOS" (which is also the generic acronym for disk operating system). MS-DOS was the main operating system for IBM PC compatibles during the 1980s, from which point it was gradually superseded by operating systems offering a graphical user interface (GUI), in various generations of the graphical Microsoft Windows operating system. 

IBM licensed and re-released it in 1981 as PC DOS 1.0 for use in its PCs. Although MS-DOS and PC DOS were initially developed in parallel by Microsoft and IBM, the two products diverged after twelve years, in 1993. 

Ultimately, it was the key product in Microsoft's development from a programming language company to a diverse software development firm, providing the company with essential revenue and marketing resources. It was also the underlying basic operating system on which early versions of Windows ran as a GUI.

rows.text: Will, there are moments in life when we find ourselves in the midst of doing something that is completely uncharacteristic almost as if we are outside of ourselves watching and saying "what the hell am I doing" and the moment it happens we are snapped back and the realisation of what we did sets in. The backlash was inevitable and I am sure that you have re lived that moment a million times trying to find any rational reason for your actions and unsurprisingly you can't and that is the positive part  because It demonstrates that you are a normal person. There are many incidents where someone has done something bad but is not prepared to accept they were wrong and have stood defient. I am sure that a lot of people will be thinking that all this contrition is just a way of limiting damage but I believe you are genuinely sorry and would give anything for this to have not happened. I believe that you are struggling with the damage to friendships and family but there is one thing to remember, you will never lose a real friend. They will be the ones who will call you out but they will also know that this is not the Will Smith they know and love. They will be the ones who will guide you towards the right path to build bridges and they will always be there to help the healing. I am a fan of your work and have no doubt that you will be ok in time. You just need to give yourself a break. Go spend time away from all this and reflect on your past and what it toom to get you to where you are and channel that commitment into doing something that you always wanted to do but never had a chance to make it happen. Don't let this incident define you and go to work on building your future. Your fans and Freinds though disappointed will always have your back. I will say a prayer for you. Stay safe J.

The funny thing about apologies: it’s being ashamed of yourself and your actions, humbling yourself to the person that you hurt, admitting your mistake, saying that you’re sorry, asking for forgiveness.

And if you’re trying not to be ashamed of yourself and your actions, then you’re really not sorry.

rows.text:
Out of all the movies I have ever watched, Minions Rise of Morbius is definitely one of them. Widely regarded as one of the best sequels ever made, "The Empire Strikes Back" further develops the characters and pushes the Star Wars Universe in a new and darker direction. After the Rebels' successful victory at the Battle of Yavin, Darth Vader (James Earl Jones) has dispatched thousands of probe droids across the galaxy in search of Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), the young rebel who used the the power of the force to destroy the Death Star. Along the way, Luke faces many challenges to overcome, including a vicious Wampa, AT-AT's, the conflict between good and evil, and the ultimate decision in completing his Jedi training or risking all that he fought for. Not only does the original cast return, but new fan-favorites are introduced here as well, such as Jedi Master Yoda (Frank Oz) and Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams).

In my opinion, it's debatable to decide which is the superior film. As a kid, I always used to watch the original on VHS, DVD, and Spike TV and constantly kept skipping to the Death Star Trench sequence over and over again. I wasn't really the biggest fan of "Empire" when I was younger, but I always enjoyed watching the Battle of Hoth sequence, especially with my Dad as it's one of his favorite moments. However, the more I kept re-watching and analyzing it in its entirety, the more I begin to understand why this film was so phenomenal. There's action, drama, comedy, serious moments (the iconic "I am your father" scene), and has some of the best music that John Williams has ever done. It even ends on a cliff hanger leaving the audience on the edge of their seat asking themselves, "Now what?"

The trailer is fantastic, and I love the ending of the dance! A critic's DREAM. We follow the main character through land after land, app after app, including candy crush, Twitter, DropBox, Just Dance, message apps, Facebook, pirates bay, Spotify, and so much more! They included tutorials for the game, to try and get us to play the game! Some people say this is just a long ad, and they are right. As a consumerist, I don't mind this! This movie is so enjoyable it feels as if you are flying to your happy place! 10/10. Would watch it again 7 times! A modern classic that in the future will be looked at as nostalgia! If you see this at the bargain bin, PLEASE, buy it. This movie is too good to look over. It's insane how the director can make this good of a movie! We need a Sequal, live-action remake, musical, everything! Watch this masterpiece, and you will agree with make. thank GOD for this movie! My emotions went insane for this movie! I can not believe how they made a movie about emojis turn into the entertainment powerhouse! I love emojis I want to be an emoji so much, I love it!

Pikachu[a] is a fictional species in the Pokémon media franchise. Designed by Atsuko Nishida and Ken Sugimori, Pikachu first appeared in the 1996 Japanese video games Pokémon Red and Green created by Game Freak and Nintendo, which were released outside of Japan in 1998 as Pokémon Red and Blue. Pikachu is a yellow, mouse-like creature with electrical abilities. It is a major character in the Pokémon franchise, serving as its mascot and as a major mascot for Nintendo.

Pikachu is widely considered to be the most popular and well-known Pokémon species, largely due to its appearance in the Pokémon anime television series as the companion of protagonist Ash Ketchum. In most vocalized appearances Pikachu is voiced by Ikue Ōtani, though it has been portrayed by other actors, notably Ryan Reynolds in the live-action animated film Pokémon Detective Pikachu. Pikachu has been well received by critics, with particular praise given for its cuteness, and has come to be regarded as an icon of Japanese pop culture.

rows.text:
Anger Management:

1. Think before you speak


In the heat of the moment, it's easy to say something you'll later regret. Take a few moments to collect your thoughts before saying anything. Also allow others involved in the situation to do the same.



2. Once you're calm, express your concerns

As soon as you're thinking clearly, express your frustration in an assertive but nonconfrontational way. State your concerns and needs clearly and directly, without hurting others or trying to control them.



3. Get some exercise

Physical activity can help reduce stress that can cause you to become angry. If you feel your anger escalating, go for a brisk walk or run. Or spend some time doing other enjoyable physical activities.



4. Take a timeout

Timeouts aren't just for kids. Give yourself short breaks during times of the day that tend to be stressful. A few moments of quiet time might help you feel better prepared to handle what's ahead without getting irritated or angry.
5. Identify possible solutions

Instead of focusing on what made you mad, work on resolving the issue at hand. Does your child's messy room make you upset? Close the door. Is your partner late for dinner every night? Schedule meals later in the evening. Or agree to eat on your own a few times a week. Also, understand that some things are simply out of your control. Try to be realistic about what you can and cannot change. Remind yourself that anger won't fix anything and might only make it worse.
6. Stick with 'I' statements

Criticizing or placing blame might only increase tension. Instead, use "I" statements to describe the problem. Be respectful and specific. For example, say, "I'm upset that you left the table without offering to help with the dishes" instead of "You never do any housework."



7. Don't hold a grudge

Forgiveness is a powerful tool. If you allow anger and other negative feelings to crowd out positive feelings, you might find yourself swallowed up by your own bitterness or sense of injustice. Forgiving someone who angered you might help you both learn from the situation and strengthen your relationship.



8. Use humor to release tension

Lightening up can help diffuse tension. Use humor to help you face what's making you angry and, possibly, any unrealistic expectations you have for how things should go. Avoid sarcasm, though — it can hurt feelings and make things worse.



9. Practice relaxation skills

When your temper flares, put relaxation skills to work. Practice deep-breathing exercises, imagine a relaxing scene, or repeat a calming word or phrase, such as "Take it easy." You might also listen to music, write in a journal or do a few yoga poses — whatever it takes to encourage relaxation.



10. Know when to seek help

Learning to control anger can be a challenge at times. Seek help for anger issues if your anger seems out of control, causes you to do things you regret or hurts those around you.

rows.text:
To me he sounds sincere and I sympathize with what he's going through.  I don't think people should boil his entire career and accomplishments down to 5 minutes where he made such a horrible decision.  He was 100% wrong in every aspect of his behavior that night.  His actions in that moment revealed a colossally huge lack of good judgment, and possibly a character flaw that may have been simmering beneath the surface for a long time.  But I don't think it would be fair to judge anyone based on their worst moment and ignore everything good  they've done prior. 

I'm glad he's seeing a behaviorist because he definitely needs to understand where that Impulse came from. That's the best way to make sure this doesn't happen again.  

I like Will Smith.  I like his movies, his TV series, his music and his family.  I hope he gets past this so we can see him doing what he does best, entertaining fans and sharing his gift all over the world.  

I also like Chris and I hope he's dealing with this in a healthy way.  I don't think an apology on video or one shared privately would make up for what Will did to him, but I hope these two majorly talented black men can someday become friends.

rows.text:
"Trying to be remorseful without feeling like a piece of 💩" is the difference between an #apology and a #sorry...

An apology is just an explanation,  acknowledgement and onus of what happened... The etymology of the word apology is Greek apologia meaning a "defence, story, justification, account". So just because someone apologises doesn't mean they feel/are sorry... Sorry is an old English word meaning to be "grieved, feel SORROW". 'Sorry' comes from 'sorrow' ; you can't be sorry without feeling sorrow (like 💩)... When someone is sorry they actually HAVE TO #FEEL bad (like a piece 💩) and remorseful. 🤷🏾‍♂️

An apology is NOT a #feeling, sorry and remorse ARE. 
Trying NOT to feel bad "like 💩" whilst simultaneously trying to be remorseful is like trying to swim and not get (feel) wet... it's a Sisyphean contradicting paradox. #impossible 

Mr William's speech comes off more as an a apology trying to be a sorry... Remorse and sorrow aren't emotions you TRY to have/be; you either are sorry and own the feeling of being a piece of 💩 
OR you give people an apology (account, defense, story).

UUmmm...Why not just say (Without all the production of sighing and camera angles): 

''Listen ya'll, I'm gonna make this short. I really fuk&D up. I'm working through things. I've got issues and a dark side I'm working through. I'm in anger management, even taking a few pills (for example). AND I‘m not perfect. No words can take back my actions, but I just wanted to shine some light on where I'm at right now..'' DONE(Then, answers questions straight forward, sincerely, without laughter).

Instead, you get an apology that seems scripted in some way, or at least solely directed towards a fanbase that might be appalled, not at him as a person, but as the 'squeaky clean' public persona he has created throughout his life. This feels more like trying to save his image, not him. 

The ''I promise we can be friends, or the ''I promise I am deeply committed to putting light and love int o the world..''... Though he might WANT to mean that, he has to know that trying to change or do serious inner work, never starts with an 'I promise.'  Promises are for fools, politicians, PR agencies, and people desperate for the approval of others. You don't promise, you ACT! And you let time weave its web.

I would say to Will, don't suppress the darkness! Let it out, open it up, go with it, just be honest about it with people. I don't think trying to resuscitate your image (preslap) will ever cut the mustard.  Noone is perfect and everyone has a dark side. Claim your failure! Shame only comes when you try to bury it.

Researcher Aaron Lazare studied apologies for years, and concluded that an effective apology has four parts: 

1. It acknowledges the offense (who did the harm to whom, and exactly what the harm was), 
2. offers an explanation for the offense (not an excuse, but an explanation), 
3. expresses remorse or shame (some recognition of the depth of suffering caused is needed here), and 
4. involves a repair of some kind (compensation, in a real or symbolic way, for the offender’s transgression)

it seems several of these elements are missing here. wdyt?

His dodging of actually accepting responsibility appalling. 
2:45-ish"There is no part of me ..." He's not even really acknowledge that he made a cognizant decision to get up and move toward Chris. If no part of him thought or believed that, the event would not have occurred. A real apology would acknowledge and confront that which, in himself, made it OK. 
4:25-ish. What about those who felt let down by him. He talks about HIS central trauma. About how hard this is on HIM WHAT?!! Talk about self-serving. 
4:55 Being remorseful without being ashamed of myself. Good Lord. No, no, Will you can't feel a true apology and heal from it until you DO admit that, at that moment, you were a piece of SH**. Doesn't mean that you always were, doesn't mean that you are now. But at that moment, boyo, you were. 

But, son, this came across as if you hired Mark Bowden from the Behavior Panel to help you "communicate clearly and effectively along with members of the G7" to manage your appearance. And it feels fake, even if it isn't.

The best apology would not involve a fancy set up. Hand held camera, not a production. Maybe in a back yard or a messy room or a noisy bar. Script reads simply. Address Chris. Acknowledge you were a piece of sh** when you did that. Now you are working on improving yourself. "At (whatever) years old, I really should have left all that behind long before now and what happened proves I haven't. Gonna work on it, man, gonna work on it. You said you'd contact me when you were ready to talk. Whenever, man, whenever. I just hope it's soon. And for your mom, Ma'am I'm so, so sorry. I was just way beyond out of line and I know nothing I say can EVER be enough. I'm just so sorry. And Tony, you were my man. I don't know. I just don't know. Can we work on moving past this? What can I do? Can't make it right, because it wasn't. But can we work on moving past? Let me know. And for my fans, I'm sorry I upset and disappointed you. It shouldn't have happened and I know that. But it did. I hope over time I can regain your trust and support. 

THIS we would believe. But not the fancy, dancy you did. High production value = fake.

rows.text:
Apology is the expression of regret or remorse for an offense or injury. Forgiveness is the pardon for something that has been done. This is the key difference between apology and forgiveness. Making apologies and granting forgiveness are vital aspects in any type of relationship, even the one you had with Chris. It is a thing that goes both ways. Apologize - this shows that you understand what you've done, and then ask for forgiveness from the person.
One of the things here is also trying to forgive yourself, learn from it and rise above it. Actions speak louder than any words. Be yourself, do what you believe is right and do it sincerily. This is how you should show the world that you're "putting light and love and joy into the world."

Also, I know that you don't want to admit it and I see you feel deep shame. You closed your eyes for long periods of time when saying them, which shows that you have pride in you, still. Pride is what lead you to this whole situation. Pride is also hiding your emotions and what you really think. In order to fix this - you need to talk. You need to share and not only with your closest friends or family, but with your fans and supporters. 

A quote from Game of Thrones: 
“A good act does not wash out the bad, nor a bad act the good. Each should have its own reward." - and your reward for your bad act here is to learn what has happened and be a better person tomorrow. Focus inwards to amend so tomorrow you can give to the world that light and love and joy you wish to give. Only then, I'll believe your words and acts are true.

rows.text:
1) Grace and Mercy is available for us all. That does NOT exclude YOU, Will.
2) If you believe in God, He has ALREADY forgiven you. The hardest part is to forgive yourself. 
3) You ARE human as is the rest of us. There is not one human breathing that has not ever made a mistake. No stones should be thrown here, but people will try to as a diversion from admitting and/or dealing with their own mess ups. Especially by behaving as if YOU'VE carried out the most unforgivable act EVER heard or seen upon the earth. There's been worse before AND since what we witnessed with you. They know it and some of THEM are the ones that did it. That's more about THEM than you. Ignore it. 
4) You're doing all that's humanly possible to do.  You did what you did publicly, so ADMITTING the wrong and APOLOGIZING publicly was necessary. I'm sure you've attempted to do it privately as well.
5) Chris now has a choice to forgive ... or not. That's up to him. 
6) You ARE NOT a piece of ____. You're a beautiful human being with a heart who is not perfect. You walk, talk, hurt, cry, breathe, bleed, mess up, fall, get back up, go to sleep, and try again tomorrow; just like the rest of us. You just have more people watching than most of us; therefore, you have more self-appointed unqualified judges as well. 

Don't continue to worry yourself with what you can't control, especially since others have no control over your destiny. This too shall pass. No one can undo yesterday (only in the movies).   But, we've all had experiences that we WISH we could. Don't allow the world to hold YOU to a standard that they can't even accomplish because IT'S NOT HUMANLY POSSIBLE. 

I pray that Chris forgives you and your relationship can be healed. However it that doesn't happen, the wiorld is still turning, time is still moving, and life continues to go on. So continue to live yours.❤️

rows.text: The judgemental and crucifying tone of so many comments on here, to me, are worse than that of the situation itself. "Forgive them, for they know not what they do" comes to mind. It takes an insurmountable amount of courage to ask for forgiveness let alone to forgive oneself. Most of us are lucky enough to not have to be publicly scrutinised and held "accountable"... oh the shame! This is deeper than surface level conflict. This is years of Wounds, trauma and conditioning playing out. And not just by the individuals involved. They are but characters revealing to us all the inhumane treatment we portray towards each other. Personally I thank Will and Chris for being the characters on the world stage showing us all exactly what is wrong in this world. The boxes, structures and thought systems that have been ruling this reality for far too long where one is a victim and another a perpetrator. Even though they are both subtle in projecting their Wounds onto one another. As we all do!!!

rows.text: I made a severe and continuous lapse in my judgement, and I don’t expect to be forgiven. I’m simply here to apologize. What we came across that day in the woods was obviously unplanned. The reactions you saw on tape were raw; they were unfiltered. None of us knew how to react or how to feel. I should have never posted the video. I should have put the cameras down and stopped recording what we were going through. There's a lot of things I should have done differently but I didn't. And for that, from the bottom of my heart, I am sorry. I want to apologize to the internet. I want to apologize to anyone who has seen the video. I want to apologize to anyone who has been affected or touched by mental illness, or depression, or su*cide. But most importantly I want to apologize to the victim and his family. For my fans who are defending my actions, please don't. I don’t deserve to be defended. The goal with my content is always to entertain; to push the boundaries, to be all-inclusive. In the world I live in, I share almost everything I do. The intent is never to be heartless, cruel, or malicious. Like I said I made a huge mistake. I don’t expect to be forgiven, I’m just here to apologize. I'm ashamed of myself. I’m disappointed in myself. And I promise to be better. I will be better. Thank you
